# Per-cell metadata, keyed to the shared rofi registry by Category + Label.
# PROPOSAL B KEEPS THE MAIN DOCK COMPACT. This file used to carry 149 rows: 126 cells and 23 separators,
# spread over 15 window icons, 8 direct-action cells and 6 sub-docks, for 29
# icons on the bar. Every one of those cells still exists and still runs the same
# command; they now live inside GTK command windows (kodachi_windows.py), which
# resolve the SAME (Category, Label) pairs against the SAME registry. Nothing was
# deleted, it moved one level in.
#    1 grouped Quick GTK surface on the main dock
#   11 _WINDOW_ rows inside the More sub-dock and one inside Containers
#    4 _SEP_ rows: three defining the running, application and quick-command
#      regions of the main dock, and one divider the operator added by hand
#  107 _LAUNCH_ rows, one direct Dashboard launcher on the main dock plus 106
#      direct application launchers spread over 9 sub-docks (More 3, Browsers 3,
#      Terminals 16, Security 12, Encryption 9, Net Tools 12, Utilities 22,
#      FOUR SCATTERED FIREJAIL CELLS WERE CONSOLIDATED INTO ONE WINDOW ON
#      2026-08-25, AND THE Containers GROUP WAS KEPT IN FULL. The operator's
#      words were "can user use it easly its confiusing": Firejail and Podman
#      were thirteen cells across four groups for a decision with one sentence
#      in it, choose an application then choose how isolated it runs. What was
#      confusing was the SCATTER, not the Containers group, and he ruled on that
#      directly: "do not remove the cairo doc group conainers that has 8 icons
#      only add the sandbox aplications icon to it so the sanbox applications
#      becaome the first one .. i love the icons". So `_WINDOW_ isolation` is now
#      the FIRST cell of Containers, ahead of its eight shortcuts, and it opens
#      the window that holds every Firejail and Podman control including theirs.
#      REMOVED, all four outside the Containers group and all four duplicated by
#      a cell inside it or by a window destination: kodachi-browser-firejail
#      (Browsers) and firejail-terminal (Terminals), which both ran a BARE
#      `firejail <program>` and bypassed the validated wrapper entirely, and
#      container-firejail-terminal go through the wrapper and remain; plus
#      which are now expert-tool rows on the window's Profiles destination.
#      40 launchers were added on 2026-08-24 after an operator-approved census
#      of every visible .desktop entry in the PRISTINE ISO
#      apps, 52 already on the dock). Each of the 40 was launch-tested on
#      testvm-kodachi-91fb5c before it was proposed. TWO OF THEM ARE SYSTEM-TRAY
#      APPLETS AND OPEN NO WINDOW: `firetools` (Firejail Sandbox Manager) and
#      `redshift-gtk` (Redshift Night Colour). That is upstream behaviour, not a
#      broken cell, and the operator approved them knowing it.
#    3 registry cells that launch programs, all in Browsers
#   13 generated main-dock icons across these regions, plus Application Menu,
#      Show Desktop, Quick Browser, the Trash (dustbin) applet and Cairo-Dock's
# Quick Browser remains the operator-selected folder-choice popup.
# THERE IS NO `trash-folder` _LAUNCH_ ROW ANY MORE, AND THAT IS A REVERSAL.
# It existed because of a claim that the dustbin APPLET "failed to open on both
# test VMs", so a deterministic `thunar trash:///` launcher was shipped in its
# place. THAT CLAIM CARRIES NO EVIDENCE, measured 2026-08-21 by <agent>:
# `git log -S` puts the sentence in 176ce0d44 "feat(cairo-dock): add proposal B
# quick deck" (<agent>, 2026-08-20 10:34), whose entire commit body is the
# subject line plus an Agent-ID trailer. No VM named, no symptom, no artifact, no
# date of the observation. So this reversal overturns an unattributed assertion,
# not a measurement, and it must not be restated as though a test had been run.
# The cost of that trade is what the operator saw on 2026-08-21: a launcher is a
# static icon, so it cannot show whether the bin holds anything, and it sat two
# cells away from the dustbin applet this host has enabled, drawing the SAME
# wastebasket twice. The applet is the surface that reports state, so the applet
# is what ships, with `empty image` / `full image` in
# theme/plug-ins/dustbin/dustbin.conf carrying the same wastebasket artwork the
# launcher wore, plus `quick info=1` for the item count.
# THE APPLET DOES SHIP: `cairo-dock-plug-ins` is in the ISO package list
# gui-xfce.list.chroot:171) and `apt-cache depends` shows it Depends on
# cairo-dock-dustbin-plug-in exactly as it does on cairo-dock-showdesktop-plug-in
# and cairo-dock-gmenu-plug-in, the two applets this dock already relies on.
# Enabling dustbin therefore adds no package. That is a package-list check, not a
# WHAT IS NOT RE-PROVEN BY THAT REVERSAL: the applet's open action works on THIS
# host, and the recorded VM failure has not been re-tested. Re-test `dustbin`
# left-click on a test VM before the next ISO; if it still fails there, the fix
# belongs in the applet's file-manager invocation, not in a second trash icon.
# THE PRISTINE ISO CENSUS PLUS THE OPERATOR'S APPROVAL IS THE SOURCE FOR
# APPLICATION MEMBERSHIP, never this host's panel and never a booted VM's
# writable overlay. The executable contract in tests/test_quick_deck.py pins the
# one authoritative count block above, so a row change cannot leave a second
# prose manifest contradicting it. GitKraken, Obsidian, Session, Tabby and
# VSCodium do ship in the pristine image; they are absent here because the
# operator explicitly declined them on 2026-08-24, not because the software is
# missing. Chromium and Firefox ESR were excluded because that same pristine
# census showed they do not ship.
# A _LAUNCH_ row carries its Exec VERBATIM in the Payload column and does NOT go
# through the action runner. The runner authenticates and audits Kodachi
# actions; making it gate `veracrypt` would demand a signature check to open a
# GUI. NeedsAuth, Timeout and Sound are inert for these rows and are 0.
# Order follows the generated contract: Dashboard, Quick, More, Running
# Applications, Applications, eight application groups, then Quick Commands.
# Quick presents eight compact groups. More preserves all full GTK windows.
# Columns: Category Label Subdock DockLabel Icon NeedsAuth Timeout Payload Sound
# A _WINDOW_ row is not a registry action: kodachi-dock-build writes
# `Exec=kodachi-command-window <Label>` for it and it bypasses the runner on
# purpose, because registering GTK entries in menu-actions.sh would ship
# graphical-only rows onto the headless terminal image. NeedsAuth, Timeout and
# Payload are therefore all inert for those rows and are written as 0/0/none.
# is moved to a STRANDED COMMENTS section at the end for you to re-file.
# MAIN-DOCK ORDER IS FILE ORDER, STEPPING OVER EVERY Order A CONTAINER OWNS.
# dock-layout.tsv owns Orders 3, 4 and 7..13, so the five main-dock rows below
# take 1, 2, 5, 6 and 14 in file order: Dashboard, Quick, then the separators.
# Cairo-Dock inserts live application icons using the "Running Applications"
# separator as the exact relative-icon anchor, named by `relative icon=` in
# theme/cairo-dock.conf and theme/cairo-dock-simple.conf. THAT ANCHOR IS A
# GENERATED FILENAME, so it moves whenever the main-dock order changes: this
# .desktop, and both confs were updated with it. Re-read it from a throwaway
# build after any future rearrangement instead of assuming it survived.
# CAPTURED FROM THE OPERATOR'S OWN REARRANGEMENT, made with the mouse on
# 2026-08-21 between 18:07 and 18:19. He deleted the `Kodachi` sub-dock: the
# Dashboard came out onto the main dock at 1, and Kodachi Repository Manager,
# Kodachi Quick Actions and Rofi Apps moved into More behind a divider he added
# by hand. More itself moved from the far right to 3, Security and Encryption
# swapped, and Utilities and Files swapped. The four applets moved with it and
# their positions live in their own confs, not here:
# showDesktop 3.5, GMenu (Application Menu) 5.5, Quick Browser 36, dustbin 37.
# Label names the region that FOLLOWS it, which is what `export` writes back.
# NOTE: `kodachi-dock-build export` still does NOT emit these body comments, but
# you no longer have to re-add them by hand. sync-cairo-dock.sh re-grafts every
# comment block onto the data row it sits above, so `capture` round-trips this
# file byte for byte. A block whose anchor row leaves the dock is NOT dropped: it
# is moved to a STRANDED COMMENTS section at the end for you to re-file.
# SECOND REARRANGEMENT, captured 2026-08-25 from the same live dock. He moved
# Qalculate! out of Files and into Utilities (Files 21 -> 20 launchers,
# Utilities 21 -> 22), reordered Browsers, Files, Net Tools, Terminals and
# Utilities in place, and replaced four icons with his own picks. The four he
# picked came out of the capture as /home/<user>/Desktop/PNG-ALL/*.png, which
# is a PER-USER PICKER PATH that ships as a broken icon on every other machine,
# so each one was copied into usr/share/kodachi/dock/icons/custom/ under its
# slug and the row repointed at the shipped copy: isolation, monero-gui-wallet,
# THIRD REARRANGEMENT, captured 2026-08-28 from the same live dock. Containers
# moved from the far right to main-dock Order 3, More moved to 4, and Browsers
# through Files shifted to 7..13. Notes moved from Files to Utilities;
# Screenshot and LibreOffice moved into Files; Geany, Font Manager and Clipboard
# Manager changed position inside Utilities. The translated applet positions are
# showDesktop 0.5 and GMenu 6.5; Quick Browser remains 24.
# CAPTURE NOW PRESERVES ESTABLISHED SLUGS. A generated .desktop carries Name,
# Icon, Exec and Order and no slug field, so the exporter derives a slug from
# the label. `preserve_exported_slugs` maps each established row by kind, label
# and Exec before comment re-grafting, including rows moved between groups. New
# live rows have no established identity and keep the exported slug.
# ── Containers (9 cells: the Isolation Manager window first, then the six Podman controls and the two Firejail shortcuts the operator kept) ──
# ── More (15 rows: 11 full GTK control surfaces, then the Kodachi Repository
# ── Manager, then a hand-added divider with the two cells that used to be the
# ── Kodachi sub-dock behind it. Counted as ROWS, not cells, because More is the
# ── only section that contains a _SEP_ and a divider is not a cell) ──
